label: rem:surreal-blowup-literal
title: Every step of the surreal blow-up is a literal surreal object
html:
The field \mathbf{No} makes every step of the blow-up literal. The cutoff \Lambda is a specific element. The counterterm is a specific surreal-valued function. The standard part is a specific real number.

Named surreals. In the surreal blow-up calculus, \omega = 1/\varepsilon; see Table for named surreals, each of which corresponds to a unique element under Conway's recursive construction. Procedurally, a surreal blow-up evaluates a divergent expression at a named infinite surreal, then takes the standard part of a renormalised version.
